english.title: Knowingly publish false statement of candidates withdrawal from election
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that, before or during an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you knowingly published a false statement of the withdrawal of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at the election for the purpose of promoting or procuring the election of another candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER CANDIDATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 106(5) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
